# School vocabulary

## What you will learn
Classroom words include teacher, student, desk, board, notebook and lesson. Use a/an for one countable object.

## Example in context
There is a notebook on my desk. Our teacher writes on the board.

## How to use it
Read the example aloud. Identify the rule, then make a new sentence with your own words. Check word order and spelling.

## Common mistake
A notebook is singular; notebooks is plural.

## Practice and reflection
Complete: There is ___ desk in the classroom.
**Model answer:** a

Try changing one word in the example without breaking the rule.
levels.easy:
## In simple words
Classroom words include teacher, student, desk, board, notebook and lesson. Use a/an for one countable object.

**Remember this example:** There is a notebook on my desk. Our teacher writes on the board.

**Be careful:** A notebook is singular; notebooks is plural.
